issue.title: Update Bootstrap in project templates from 5.3.3 to latest 5.x (5.3.8)
issue.body:
### Summary

The ASP.NET Core project templates ship Bootstrap **5.3.3**, which is several patch releases behind the current upstream release, **5.3.8** (released 2025-08-25). The templates should be updated to the latest 5.x so newly scaffolded apps get the current Bootstrap CSS/JS and its bug/security fixes.

### Where it is pinned

- `src/ProjectTemplates/Web.ProjectTemplates/package.json` pins `"bootstrap": "^5.3.3"`.
- The vendored copies live under each template's `wwwroot/lib/bootstrap/dist/` (for example `content/BlazorWeb-CSharp/BlazorWebCSharp.1/wwwroot/lib/bootstrap/dist/`), which currently carry the 5.3.3 build (the `bootstrap.min.css` banner reads `Bootstrap v5.3.3`).

### Expected

`dotnet new` web templates (Razor Pages, MVC, Blazor Web, etc.) ship the latest Bootstrap 5.x (currently 5.3.8), with the vendored `dist` assets and their subresource-integrity hashes regenerated to match.

### Actual

Templates ship Bootstrap 5.3.3.

### How this was found

An end-to-end validation harness that scaffolds real templates from nightly builds asserts the shipped Bootstrap version against the latest upstream 5.x (via the npm registry) and verifies every subresource-integrity hash on the page matches the served bytes. The version assertion currently fails:

```
Bootstrap is behind: shipped 5.3.3, expected 5.3.8.
Expected: "5.3.8"
But was:  "5.3.3"
```

### Notes

- Latest upstream: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases/tag/v5.3.8
- When updating, regenerate the SRI `integrity` attributes referenced from the template layouts so they match the new asset bytes.
